t: A member of the uniformed services who is retired pursuant to this title shall be retired in the rank, grade, or rating upon which his disability retirement pay is based or in such higher rank, grade, or rating as may be authorized by law at time of retirement.

fable.w: This provision only sets the rank, grade, or rating at which a disabled service member is retired. There is no tempting reading here: it involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.
fable.s: A member of the uniformed services who is retired pursuant to this title shall be retired in the rank, grade, or rating upon which his disability retirement pay is based

qwen_block.w: This section defines the rank at which a military member is retired. It involves only federal employees (uniformed services) and federal legal standards. There is no consultation, coordination, or participation by any party outside the federal government.
qwen_block.s: A member of the uniformed services who is retired pursuant to this title shall be retired in the rank, grade, or rating upon which his disability retirement pay is based or in such higher rank, grade, or rating as may be authorized by law at time of retirement.

opus.w: The section only says which rank, grade, or rating a disability-retired service member keeps. It does not require consulting outside parties, a hearing, a comment period, an advisory body, rulemaking, or a right to sue. A service member being retired is not someone outside the government taking part in a federal policy decision, so the tempting reading fails.
opus.s: A member of the uniformed services who is retired pursuant to this title shall be retired in the rank, grade, or rating upon which his disability retirement pay is based

qwen_chat.w: This section defines the rank at which a federal employee (member of the uniformed services) is retired. It involves internal government administration and statutory interpretation, not consultation or coordination with parties outside the federal government. There is no public comment period, advisory board with outside members, or consultation with states or tribes.
qwen_chat.s: A member of the uniformed services who is retired pursuant to this title shall be retired in the rank, grade, or rating upon which his disability retirement pay is based or in such higher rank, grade, or rating as may be authorized by law at time of retirement.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "authorized by law" implies some external input, but the text itself describes a purely internal administrative determination of rank and pay for a federal employee (a member of the uniformed services). There is no mention of consultation with states, the public, or outside experts. The decision is made by the government based on existing laws.
